# WebView2 Fixed Runtime

Place the unpacked x64 Microsoft Edge WebView2 Fixed Version runtime here:

```text
vendor/webview2-runtime/<version>/msedgewebview2.exe
```

At runtime the task pane checks this folder first. If no fixed runtime is present, it uses the installed Evergreen WebView2 runtime.

Official page:

```text
https://developer.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/webview2/
```
